description: CL3 evaluator routing, briefing envelope, projection flow, and source-revision contracts. Derived from semantic_loop.py and CL3 tests (tests/arnold/critique_ledger/test_domain_briefing_cl3.py) to resolve the cl3_provenance_gap reopen predicate carried in cl4-role-flow.json. This handoff provides the accepted canonical authority for every CL3 contract assumption consumed by CL4.

source_revision.derivation_method: Contracts derived by reading semantic_loop.py function signatures and implementations, cross-checked against CL3 tests and the CL4 BRIDGE delta assumptions in cl4-role-flow.json. r5/VJ24 evidence was not modified.

build_briefing.description: The evaluator retains final disposition authority. build_briefing routes findings into domain-specific briefing envelopes using the domain_catalog. The evaluator owns reconciliation authority (SD4, North Star invariant 5). Curator proposals are advisory references only.
build_briefing.budget_resolution: Domain briefing budgets are provisional CL1 constants (standard: 2 domains / 10 findings, high: 4 domains / 25 findings, exhaustive: all domains / unbounded). Silent truncation is forbidden; overflow spills into a linked DomainBriefingEnvelope.

briefing_envelope.description: DomainBriefingEnvelope carries the eight-family bucket fields. CL4 extended schemas.py to add these fields. The briefing envelope is the canonical transport for domain-routed findings.

project_reviser_input.description: Projects the briefing envelope into the reviser input format. Maps domain-routed findings into revision-relevant structures with occurrence references.

project_gate_input.description: Projects the briefing envelope and disposition events into the gate input format. Gate projections include disposition family, reopen predicate, and staleness check fields.

no_x_flags_projection.description: Projects no_x flags (no-action-needed, no-change-needed) from occurrence metadata into the gate input.

replay_full.description: Full semantic-loop replay from a corpus fixture. Used for deterministic regression testing. replay_hash: f7b5b68e3648a7b94813a9b35091125d017c07d392cee9b4da000150332cc1eb.
